title_cn: 首达时间中的隐藏路径
subtitle_en: How the full distribution of first-passage times on a ring and on 2D lattices records fast and slow routes to a target.
subtitle_cn: 环上和二维格点上，首达时间的完整分布如何记录到达目标的快路径与慢路径。
theme_en: Definition first, then computed examples on a ring and on 2D lattices, then the open question and the mathematics.
theme_cn: 先给定义，再看环和二维格点上的计算实例，最后是开放问题和数学骨架。

slides.title: Hidden routes in first-passage time
slides.sentence: On a ring with one target, a single directed shortcut can split the first-passage-time distribution into an early peak, a valley and a delayed peak.
slides.question_en: What question ties the ring and the 2D work together?
slides.question_cn: 环上的工作和二维格点上的工作，由哪个问题串起来？

evidence.alt_en: Left: schematic ring with a start, a target and a shortcut from u to v. Right: computed first-passage distribution with peaks at t = 51 and t = 1,021 and a valley at t = 290.
evidence.alt_cn: 左：带起点、目标和一条从 u 到 v 的捷径的环（示意图）。右：计算所得的首达时间分布，峰在 t = 51 和 t = 1,021，谷在 t = 290。
evidence.caption_en: f(t) = P(T = t) is the probability that the walker first reaches the target at step t. Left: schematic, not to scale. Right: computed exactly by stepping the master equation forward. Ring of N = 100 sites; start at site 1, absorbing target at site 50, one directed shortcut from site 6 to site 51. Everywhere except site 6 the walker stays, steps left or steps right with probability 1/3 each. At site 6 the shortcut is taken with probability 0.0067 per step. Peaks at t = 51 and 1,021, valley at t = 290; time axis logarithmic.
evidence.caption_cn: f(t) = P(T = t) 是游走者在第 t 步第一次到达目标的概率。左图为示意图，未按比例；右图由主方程逐步推进精确算出。环上共 N = 100 个格点；起点为第 1 格，吸收目标为第 50 格，一条单向捷径从第 6 格通到第 51 格。除第 6 格外，游走者每一步留在原地、向左、向右的概率各为 1/3。在第 6 格，每一步走捷径的概率为 0.0067。峰在 t = 51 和 1,021，谷在 t = 290；时间轴为对数刻度。

slides.title_cn: 首达时间中的隐藏路径
slides.sentence_en: On a ring with one target, a single directed shortcut can split the first-passage-time distribution into an early peak, a valley and a delayed peak.
slides.sentence_cn: 在只有一个目标的环上，一条单向捷径就能把首达时间分布分成早峰、谷和晚峰。

slides.title: What is first-passage time?
slides.sentence: It is the first time a walker reaches a target.
slides.question_en: What quantity are we actually measuring?
slides.question_cn: 我们到底在测量什么量？
slides.sentence_en: It is the first time a walker reaches a target.
slides.sentence_cn: 它是随机游走者第一次到达目标的时刻。

slides.title: Why a double peak matters
slides.sentence: A single peak usually means one dominant arrival timescale. A double peak often signals two groups of paths with different delays; the mechanism still has to be checked.
slides.question_en: Why look at the whole distribution instead of one average time?
slides.question_cn: 为什么要看整条分布，而不是只看一个平均时间？

evidence.alt_en: Schematic: a single-peaked curve and a double-peaked curve with peak 1, valley and peak 2 marked.
evidence.alt_cn: 示意图：一条单峰曲线和一条标出峰 1、谷、峰 2 的双峰曲线。
evidence.caption_en: Schematic, not computed: illustrative shapes only. Both curves start at zero (start and target differ) and decay at long times.
evidence.caption_cn: 示意图，非计算结果，仅示意形状。两条曲线都从零开始（起点与目标不同），并在长时间后衰减。

slides.sentence_en: A single peak usually means one dominant arrival timescale. A double peak often signals two groups of paths with different delays; the mechanism still has to be checked.
slides.sentence_cn: 单峰通常意味着只有一个主导的到达时间尺度；双峰往往提示存在两类延迟不同的路径，但具体机制仍需核实。

slides.title: One ring, one shortcut: one sharp case and one split case
slides.sentence: Same ring, same shortcut, two rules at the shortcut site. Taken often, the shortcut gives one sharp peak and a long tail; taken rarely, the distribution splits into an early peak carried by shortcut users and a late peak mostly made of walkers that never used it.
slides.question_en: How does one minimal shortcut model give one peak under one rule and two peaks under another?
slides.question_cn: 同一个最简单的捷径模型，为什么换一条规则就从单峰变成双峰？

evidence.alt_en: Computed f(t) for two rules at site 6: with shortcut probability 1/4, one sharp peak at t = 27 and a long tail; with shortcut probability 0.0067, peaks at t = 51 and t = 1,021 and a valley at t = 290.
evidence.alt_cn: 第 6 格两种规则下计算所得的 f(t)：走捷径概率为 1/4 时，t = 27 处一个尖峰加长尾；走捷径概率为 0.0067 时，峰在 t = 51 和 t = 1,021，谷在 t = 290。
evidence.caption_en: Ring of N = 100 sites; start at site 1, absorbing target at site 50, one directed shortcut from site 6 to site 51. Everywhere except site 6 the walker stays, steps left or steps right with probability 1/3 each. At site 6: top, stay, left, right and shortcut 1/4 each; bottom, the shortcut takes probability 0.0067 from staying. Computed exactly by stepping the master equation forward, tracking whether each walker has used the shortcut. A peak is a strict local maximum above 10⁻⁷ that is at least 1% of the highest (the report's criterion). Time axes logarithmic; the two y-axes differ.
evidence.caption_cn: 环上共 N = 100 个格点；起点为第 1 格，吸收目标为第 50 格，一条单向捷径从第 6 格通到第 51 格。除第 6 格外，游走者每一步留在原地、向左、向右的概率各为 1/3。第 6 格：上图留在原地、向左、向右、走捷径各 1/4；下图走捷径的概率 0.0067 取自留在原地的概率。由主方程逐步推进精确算出，并记录每个游走者是否走过捷径。峰的判据与报告相同：严格局部极大、高于 10⁻⁷、且不低于最高峰的 1%。时间轴为对数刻度，上下两图纵轴量级不同。

slides.title_en: One ring, one shortcut: one sharp case and one split case
slides.title_cn: 同一个环、同一条捷径：一种尖锐单峰，一种分成两峰
slides.sentence_en: Same ring, same shortcut, two rules at the shortcut site. Taken often, the shortcut gives one sharp peak and a long tail; taken rarely, the distribution splits into an early peak carried by shortcut users and a late peak mostly made of walkers that never used it.
slides.sentence_cn: 同一个环、同一条捷径，只改捷径起点处的规则。捷径常被走时，分布是一个尖峰加长尾；很少被走时，分布分成两峰：早峰来自走了捷径的游走者，晚峰主要来自从未走过捷径的游走者。

slides.title: Where the shortcut lands decides whether a second peak appears
slides.sentence: On a second ring model, only landing sites 36–39 and 62–64 give a well-separated second peak. When the shortcut lands within 7 sites of the target (43–57), the two maxima are only 2–4 steps apart, and for most landing sites there is no second peak at all.
slides.question_en: What does scanning the shortcut's landing site add beyond the single example?
slides.question_cn: 扫描捷径的落点，比单个例子多告诉了我们什么？

evidence.alt_en: Destination scan: second-peak height and the two peak times against the shortcut's landing site; well-separated second peaks only for landing sites 36–39 and 62–64.
evidence.alt_cn: 落点扫描：第二峰高度和两峰时间随捷径落点的变化；只有落点 36–39 和 62–64 出现分得开的第二峰。
evidence.caption_en: A different model from the previous slide: ring of N = 100 sites where each step goes to one of the 6 nearest sites (±1, ±2, ±3) with equal probability; start = site 1 = source of the shortcut; target at site 50 (absorbing); at site 1 the shortcut is one extra, equally likely option. f(t) from numerical inversion of the generating function (Abate–Whitt). Second peak as in the report: a strict local maximum above 10⁻⁷ that is at least 1% of the highest. A(t₂) is the height of f at the second peak. Landing sites 2–4 and 98–100 are already neighbours of site 1 and are not scanned.
evidence.caption_cn: 与上一页不是同一个模型：环上共 N = 100 个格点，每一步等概率跳到最近的 6 个格点之一（±1、±2、±3）；起点为第 1 格，也是捷径的出发点；目标为第 50 格（吸收）；在第 1 格，捷径是多出来的一个等概率选项。f(t) 由生成函数的数值反演（Abate–Whitt 方法）得到。第二峰判据与报告相同：严格局部极大、高于 10⁻⁷、且不低于最高峰的 1%。A(t₂) 是第二峰处 f 的高度。落点 2–4 和 98–100 本来就是第 1 格的邻居，不在扫描之列。

slides.title_en: Where the shortcut lands decides whether a second peak appears
slides.title_cn: 捷径落在哪里，决定第二峰是否出现
slides.sentence_en: On a second ring model, only landing sites 36–39 and 62–64 give a well-separated second peak. When the shortcut lands within 7 sites of the target (43–57), the two maxima are only 2–4 steps apart, and for most landing sites there is no second peak at all.
slides.sentence_cn: 在另一个环模型上，只有落点在 36–39 和 62–64 时才出现分得开的第二峰；落点在目标两侧 7 格以内（43–57）时，两个极大只差 2–4 步；大多数落点根本没有第二峰。

slides.title: Two 2D layouts that keep two timescales visible
slides.sentence: On a rectangular lattice with a weak uniform drift, a corridor with leaky walls (one target) and an open lattice with a near and a far target (no corridor) both give a clear double peak, and in both the double peak depends on the drift.
slides.question_en: What kinds of 2D layout actually keep a double peak visible?
slides.question_cn: 什么样的二维布局才能让双峰保持可见？

evidence.alt_en: Computed first-passage distributions for two 2D layouts: one target in a corridor with leaky walls (peaks at t = 394 and 1,696) and two targets without a corridor (peaks at t = 11 and 739).
evidence.alt_cn: 两种二维布局计算所得的首达时间分布：通道壁可渗漏的单目标布局（峰在 t = 394 和 1,696），以及没有通道的双目标布局（峰在 t = 11 和 739）。
evidence.caption_en: Reflecting rectangular lattice, 60 sites long and 16 wide; each step the walker moves to a neighbour with total probability 0.8 (otherwise it stays), with a uniform drift b_x along the long side. Start at x = 7, far target at x = 58; f(t) computed exactly from the transition probabilities up to t = 5,000. Top: drift b_x = −0.08 (away from the target) and a corridor 5 sites wide on the midline that pushes the walker towards the target; its walls (x = 5–54, open at both ends) let an attempted crossing through with probability κ = 0.002. Bottom: no corridor, drift b_x = +0.07 (towards the far target); a second target 2 sites along and 3 across from the start. The drift matters: in this report's two-target scan, b_x = 0 gives a single peak, and in the corridor scan of the rectangular-lattice report (same start and target) a clear double peak appears only at b_x = −0.08. Peak and valley times come from the report's classifier, which rates both curves 'clear double peak'. Insets are schematic.
evidence.caption_cn: 反射边界的矩形格点，长 60、宽 16；游走者每一步以总概率 0.8 移向相邻格点（否则留在原地），并带一个沿长边方向的均匀漂移 b_x。起点在 x = 7，远目标在 x = 58；f(t) 由转移概率精确算到 t = 5,000。上图：漂移 b_x = −0.08（背离目标），中线上有一条宽 5 格、把游走者推向目标的通道；通道壁位于 x = 5–54、两端开口，每次穿越尝试以概率 κ = 0.002 被放行。下图：没有通道，漂移 b_x = +0.07（朝向远目标）；第二个目标距起点沿长边 2 格、沿短边 3 格。漂移是关键：本报告的双目标扫描中，b_x = 0 时只有单峰；矩形格点报告的通道扫描（起点和目标相同）中，只有 b_x = −0.08 时才出现清楚的双峰。峰和谷的时刻取自报告的分类器，它把两条曲线都判为「清楚的双峰」。小图为示意。

slides.kicker_en: From one target to two, in 2D
slides.kicker_cn: 二维：从一个目标到两个目标
slides.title_en: Two 2D layouts that keep two timescales visible
slides.title_cn: 两种保留两个时间尺度的二维布局
slides.sentence_en: On a rectangular lattice with a weak uniform drift, a corridor with leaky walls (one target) and an open lattice with a near and a far target (no corridor) both give a clear double peak, and in both the double peak depends on the drift.
slides.sentence_cn: 在带弱均匀漂移的矩形格点上，带可渗漏通道壁的单目标布局，和没有通道、一近一远两个目标的布局，都给出清楚的双峰，而且两种情形的双峰都依赖这个漂移。

links.label_cn: 二维报告：半透壁与双目标

slides.title: Time outside the corridor, or crossing its wall?
slides.sentence: Compared with the valley, late hits spend far more steps outside the corridor before reaching the target (about 1,300 against 700 at κ = 0 and κ = 0.004), while the chance of having crossed a wall is almost the same in both windows.
slides.question_en: Is the late peak mainly time spent outside the corridor, or mainly the wall crossing itself?
slides.question_cn: 晚峰主要来自在通道外停留的时间，还是主要来自穿过通道壁这件事本身？

evidence.alt_en: Bar charts for a one-target corridor: expected steps outside the corridor before the hit (valley 718, 705, 815; late window 1,311, 1,288, 1,080 for κ = 0, 0.004, 0.0152) and probability of crossing a wall before the hit (0 and 0; 18.3% and 19.7%; 49.3% and 53.2%).
evidence.alt_cn: 单目标通道的柱图：到达前在通道外停留的平均步数（κ = 0、0.004、0.0152 时，谷分别为 718、705、815，晚峰时间窗分别为 1,311、1,288、1,080），以及到达前穿过通道壁的概率（0 与 0；18.3% 与 19.7%；49.3% 与 53.2%）。
evidence.caption_en: Valley/peak budget report: symmetric one-target corridor (a different corridor set-up from the previous slide). Valley and late window: hits whose times fall around the minimum and around the second maximum of f(t). κ: probability that an attempted step across a corridor wall is accepted (κ = 0: walls fully reflecting, so no crossing). Values as published in the report, which gives no uncertainty; at κ = 0.004 the report rates the late maximum as a weak double peak. The report also finds that after a first crossing, late-window paths still need more steps to reach the target (336 against 213 at κ = 0.004).
evidence.caption_cn: 谷与峰的步数账本报告：对称单目标通道（与上一页不是同一个通道设置）。谷与晚峰时间窗：到达时刻落在 f(t) 极小附近和第二个极大附近的轨迹。κ：每次试图跨过通道壁的一步被放行的概率（κ = 0 时通道壁完全反射，不会穿越）。数值取自报告原文，报告未给出误差；κ = 0.004 时，报告把晚峰判为弱双峰。报告还发现，第一次穿壁之后，晚峰时间窗的轨迹仍需更多步才到达目标（κ = 0.004 时 336 步对 213 步）。

slides.kicker_en: One-target corridor: what delays the late hits?
slides.kicker_cn: 单目标通道：晚到的轨迹慢在哪里
slides.title_en: Time outside the corridor, or crossing its wall?
slides.title_cn: 是在通道外停留，还是穿过通道壁？
slides.sentence_en: Compared with the valley, late hits spend far more steps outside the corridor before reaching the target (about 1,300 against 700 at κ = 0 and κ = 0.004), while the chance of having crossed a wall is almost the same in both windows.
slides.sentence_cn: 与谷相比，晚峰时间窗里的轨迹在到达目标前，在通道外停留的步数多得多（κ = 0 和 κ = 0.004 时约 1,300 步对 700 步）；而两个时间窗里穿过通道壁的概率几乎相同。

links.label_cn: 谷与峰的步数账本报告

slides.title: From two targets to many
slides.sentence: With two targets the peaks can belong to different targets: in the open-lattice case, the early window is all near-target hits and the late window 99.8% far-target hits. With many targets the open questions are screening, crowding and rare late winners.
slides.question_en: Where does this line of work go once there is more than one possible target?
slides.question_cn: 一旦不止一个可能的目标，这条研究线接下来往哪里走？

evidence.alt_en: Two-target lattice: f(t) split into near-target and far-target hits, and the share of near and far hits in the peak 1, valley and peak 2 windows (100% near; 73% near, 27% far; 99.8% far).
evidence.alt_cn: 双目标格点：按到达近目标和远目标拆分的 f(t)，以及峰 1、谷、峰 2 三个时间窗里近、远目标所占比例（近 100%；近 73%、远 27%；远 99.8%）。
evidence.caption_en: The two-target case of the previous slide (no corridor, drift b_x = +0.07 towards the far target; near target 2 sites along and 3 across from the start). f(t) is the sum of the near-target and far-target parts; over all times 33% of hits are at the near target and 67% at the far one. Windows as in the report: t = 1–37, 281–333 and 713–765.
evidence.caption_cn: 即上一页的双目标布局（没有通道，漂移 b_x = +0.07 朝向远目标；近目标距起点沿长边 2 格、沿短边 3 格）。f(t) 是到达近目标和远目标两部分之和；全部时间合计，33% 的到达在近目标，67% 在远目标。时间窗与报告一致：t = 1–37、281–333、713–765。

slides.title_cn: 从两个目标到多个目标
slides.sentence_en: With two targets the peaks can belong to different targets: in the open-lattice case, the early window is all near-target hits and the late window 99.8% far-target hits. With many targets the open questions are screening, crowding and rare late winners.
slides.sentence_cn: 有两个目标时，两个峰可以分属不同的目标：在没有通道的布局里，早峰时间窗全部是到达近目标的轨迹，晚峰时间窗 99.8% 是到达远目标的轨迹。目标更多时，待解的问题是屏蔽、拥挤，以及少数很晚才到达远处目标的游走者。

slides.title: Minimal mathematical backbone
slides.sentence: The same three objects underlie every figure: a master equation on the sites (ring or 2D lattice), the first-hit time T and its distribution f(t).
slides.question_en: What are the smallest equations you can keep in mind while listening to the story?
slides.question_cn: 如果只记最少的几个公式，应该记哪几个？
slides.sentence_en: The same three objects underlie every figure: a master equation on the sites (ring or 2D lattice), the first-hit time T and its distribution f(t).
slides.sentence_cn: 每一张图背后都是同样三样东西：格点（环或二维格点）上的主方程、首达时间 T，以及它的分布 f(t)。
